no_adcom_quote.quote: This Application was not presented to the Oncologic Drug Advisory Committee nor any other external consultants.

summary: No advisory committee was convened for LUMOXITI (moxetumomab pasudotox, BLA761104). The Multidisciplinary Review's Section 9 (Advisory Committee Meeting and Other External Consultations) states the application was not presented to the Oncologic Drug Advisory Committee nor any other external consultants. Because no AdComm meeting occurred, there are no committee-driven linkages to the approval.
